notes.title: Achievements are coming soon.
notes.content:
Hello all, 
First off, thank you all so much to those of your who purchased the game and to every one of my testers.

 Secondly as I have said in the past, even though I dont consider this an early access title I will still make changes and improvement to the game as much as possible, and when players report issues and request features. 

The first of these is Steam Achievements. I am currently adding the Achievements feature to the game and it should be pushed to the steam build by the end of next week. I will post another announcement if this timeline changes. 

Thanks.

Daniel Wiseman.
